Combat gear + food to defeat Count Draynor

st.t: Talk to Morgan in the north of Draynor Village.
Optional: climb the stairs in Morgan's house and search the cupboard upstairs for garlic, which weakens Count Draynor. If you don't want any, skip this step.
Talk to Dr. Harlow in the Blue Moon Inn in Varrock.
s: I need your help dealing with a vampyre.
i: A beer, or 2 coins to buy one

st.t: Buy a beer from the bartender in the Blue Moon Inn in Varrock.
s: A glass of your finest ale please.

st.t: Talk to Dr. Harlow again with a beer.

i: A beer, or 2 coins to buy one

st.t: Prepare to fight Count Draynor (level 34), and enter Draynor Manor.
Enter Draynor Manor's basement using the stairs on the east side of the manor, not through the west room.
Open the coffin and kill Count Draynor.

i: Combat gear + food to defeat Count Draynor
